notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
Howdy partner - and welcome to the third content update of Wild West Saloon. The update contains a completely new level (with new customer types, new mechanics and a new buildable object), a new mechanic for the Big City and traits for workers.

New level: Mine
In this new level you have to look after miners in addition to the normal customers.
These miners drink and eat for free, but also work in the mine and bring in additional income.

Poker table in Big City
The poker table is now available in the Big City! Up to four customers can play poker here.
The customer who wins receives a large happiness bonus and everyone else a small happiness penalty.
And of course the house (aka your saloon) earns money from every round played.

Traits for workers
All workers now have a trait that is either positive, neutral or negative. For example, some workers run faster while others clear tables more slowly.

Other changes

 Unity version has been updated.
 Improved error logging.
 2 new achievements added.
 You can now change the wall color in the build menu.


If you have any ideas or suggestions for the next updates, let me know!

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
Howdy Partner - and welcome to the second content update of Wild West Saloon. This update includes a completely new level (with new customer types, new drinks and a new buildable object), some improvements to the build menu and some changes to workers.

New Level: Hacienda
In addition to a completely new setting, the new level also has new drinks (Tequila & Rum), new customer types, a new food (Quesadilla) and a new buildable object: the Distillery.
With the Distillery you can produce your own Tequila or Rum!

Build menu
The build menu has been adjusted slightly. The list of buildable objects is now on the right side and there are now categories for better overview.
There are also now decorative objects!

Workers
When a worker is fired, other workers may become unhappy - and even quit if they are extremely unhappy. A confirmation window for firing has been added.
In addition, applicants can now be rejected. (in order to preserve space for new applicants)

Other changes

 There is now a cost column in the item prices window.
 When a new game is started, a popup is displayed which briefly explains how to unlock the next level.
 The cost of making Stew has been slightly reduced.
 Popups can now be removed instantly with a right click.
 The Delivery Station has been removed in the Military Fort level. (existing savegames are not affected)
 A new achievement has been added for the Piano.
 The item prices window now only shows Food once a Kitchen has been placed.
 A bug has been fixed where you could still play the Piano after the end of the day.
 Fixed a bug where 1, 2 & 3 keys would unpause the game while being in the pause menu.
 Fixed a bug where a worker would endlessly request a new salary.


What's next?
The next content updates will bring at least one new level and add a new unique mechanic to the Big City. There will also be new customer types, drinks and buildable/ decorative objects!

If you have any ideas or suggestions for the next updates, let me know!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Howdy Partner - and welcome to the first content update for Wild West Saloon. Besides a completely new level, the two old levels also got a few changesl! This update includes new customer types, new drinks and a new buildable object! There are also some balancing changes.
I highly recommand that you start with a new save game for each level!

Levels & Level Progression
There is now a level progression system. This means that by default all levels except the tutorial will be locked. To unlock a new level you have to build a Vault and buy a Gold Ingot in the previous level.
After completing the Tutorial you will unlock the "Small Town", after that the new level "Military Fort" and after that "Big Town" (formerly known as "Medium Town").

Small Town Changes
The Small Town now focuses on drink serving. There are two drinks available: Beer and Whisky.
There is no longer a kitchen available in the small town!

New Level Military Fort
The new Military Fort includes a medium sized saloon and is the first level where the kitchen is available.
There are also completely new customers coming to your Saloon, like Soldiers for example.
The Military Fort also introduces a new drink: Gin.

Big Town (formerly known as Medium Town) Changes
The Medium Town has been renamed to Big Town.
A new patience boosting object was added: the Piano! It also introduces a new drink (Scotch) and a brand new food: Steak.

Balancing
Max Item prices, Upgrade costs and Building costs have been adjusted. Generally the max item prices have been lowered. So make sure to check your prices again!

Other Changes

 You can now identify "special workers" by their yellow name.
 The day end statistics now include delivery costs and the costs for making Stew.
 The level selection screen has been reworked and the selected difficulty is explained in a new window.
 The building cost refund as well as the delivery fees are now based on difficulty. (Note: On normal difficulty you no longer get the full cost back when removing placed objects!)


What's next?
The next content updates will bring two new levels and add a new unique mechanic to the Big Town. Besides that there will also be new customer types, drinks and buildable objects!

If you have any ideas or suggestions for the next updates let me know!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Howdy Partner! The Demo for Wild West Saloon has been updated!
Old savegames should be compatible but I recommend that you start a new game.

Changes

 New UI - the most notable change is the new UI design. Say goodbye to these boring gray windows!
 Better "Open Saloon" Button - the button to open the saloon has been moved and now shows some useful information about the state of your saloon, e.g. if your stock is too low or if you have not enough tables.
 New buildable objects - after completing the tutorial some new buildable objects are unlocked!
 New animations & sounds - customers now have some animations. Also added more sounds (including ambience background sounds)
 New buttons to control time speed - you can speed up time now! (x2 and x3)
 Limit for Workers - the amount of waitresses is now limited by the prestige of your saloon. One waitress can be hired per 1 prestige.
 Fixes for AI Pathfinding
 Some UI fixes
 Some smaller Tutorial adjustments. Mainly text changes.

notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content:
Howdy Partner! The Demo of Wild West Saloon is now available!

In the demo you can play the tutorial of the game.

Please keep in mind that the current game is still in development and some features are missing.
The full version of the game will also include:

 Worker Happiness & Traits
 World events
 More customer types
 More maps/ levels
  ... and more!
